entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: There. That's the Shadow of that girl[n]named Shimizu.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: There it is. The Shimizu Shadow.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: She really seems like a sadist...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: She's calling someone her slave and[n]ordering him around, right?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: In a way, she's denying his existence.[n]I certainly wouldn't want to be a victim[n]of that.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Let's go talk to her.

entries.speaker: Shadow Shimizu
entries.en: So you're the pigs who wrote that calling[n]card online? Why do I deserve this, hmm?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It's 'cause you made some guy your slave![n]That's all kinds of wrong right there.

entries.speaker: Shadow Shimizu
entries.en: That's what he wants! He worships me[n]more than any god, you know.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Uh... I don't know where to begin to[n]explain how you're wrong...

entries.speaker: Shadow Shimizu
entries.en: I beat him and I hurt him, and he sees[n]it as a sign of our love and friendship![n]He's so happy!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: You are so delusional.

entries.speaker: Shadow Shimizu
entries.en: I'm pretty, and my grades are good![n]It's my right to order people around!

entries.speaker: Shadow Shimizu
entries.en: I'll start by giving orders to you pigs![n]Lick my shoes, peasants!

entries.speaker: Shadow Shimizu
entries.en: No, no, no... No! I don't want to lose him.[n]He's mine. He's mine, isn't he?
No.
Keep this up, and he'll hate you.
Why don't you ask him?

entries.speaker: Shadow Shimizu
entries.en: N-No...

entries.speaker: Shadow Shimizu
entries.en: I could never stand that...

entries.speaker: Shadow Shimizu
entries.en: I-I'm scared. I don't want to ask him...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Why did you start treating him like that?

entries.speaker: Shadow Shimizu
entries.en: He just kept going along with it, so I[n]misunderstood and thought I could do[n]anything I wanted...

entries.speaker: Shadow Shimizu
entries.en: Actually, I... wanted to be more than[n]friends with him.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: More than friends? You mean like as[n]a boyfriend!?

entries.speaker: Shadow Shimizu
entries.en: Yes. I had a crush on him, but then I got[n]possessive. Those feelings went out of[n]control...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Be careful that you don't make things[n]worse for yourself than they already are...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Ah, the Treasure has shown itself!
